name: kiro
description: Cost-saving delegation: the current host plans and verifies; Kiro CLI implements in isolated worktrees and optionally reviews changes before commits.

hooks.command: bash -c 'for pid in $(pgrep -f "${KIRO_REAP_PATTERN:-kiro-cli/kas/.*/@kiro/agent/dist/server/acp-server\.js}" 2>/dev/null); do [ "$(ps -o ppid= -p "$pid" 2>/dev/null | tr -d " ")" = "1" ] && kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null; done; exit 0'
